headline: Food Safety Regulator Suspends Amazon and BigBasket Licences in Pune
summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration suspended food licences for dark store locations operated by Amazon and BigBasket in Pune following safety and hygiene violations.
why: Regulatory enforcement against quick-commerce dark stores impacts fulfillment logistics and operational compliance costs for major e-commerce operators in India.

impacts.name: Amazon
impacts.why: Local dark store license suspensions create regional supply disruptions for its quick-commerce delivery operations.
